name: Growl dropout
desc: A grittier, FM-fed Ab-minor sub whose pattern rotates through its positions with iter while a per-cycle mask punches structural dropouts and nested half-drops into the low end. A touch of FM adds a growl edge over the sine fundamental; a slow lpf breathes over 8-16 cycles. Where .01 is a clean gated sub, this one is a restless, evolving glitch bass that never repeats the same bar twice.

code.full: note("ab1 ab1 <eb2 db2> ab1 ab1 <gb1 bb1> ab1 <ab2 eb2>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${grit}).fmh(2).fast(${rate}).attack(.006).decay(.22).sustain(.18).release(.1).shape(.3).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).mask("<1 1 [1 0] 1>").iter(4).every(8,x=>x.ply(2)).gain(${gain}).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("[ab1 ab1] ab1 <eb2 gb1> [ab1 ab2] ab1 ab1 <db2 bb1> [ab1 eb2]").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${grit}).fmh(2).fast(${rate}).attack(.005).decay(.18).sustain(.14).release(.07).shape(.35).lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).mask("<1 [1 0] 1 1>").iter(8).lastOf(4,x=>x.ply(2)).gain(${gain}).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
